verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services platform, so offering a public API with an interactive reference is a plausible question and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no API reference, developer portal, or runnable examples. The llms.txt file is crawler guidance, an adjacent feature that does not count as an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
